lines.say: {c}Five identical resistors. {vm}The voltmeter reads one volt. {q}What's the battery voltage?
Real engineering admissions test question. {pz}Pause and pick one!
{a}The voltmeter only covers this resistor: one volt. {b}Its twin matches it, {br}so that's two volts across the bottom branch.
{top}The top resistor is in parallel, so it gets two volts too.
{cur}Now zoom in on the current. {split}Twice as much goes over the top, {sum3}so three units flow through each outside resistor.
{out}Three times the current means three volts each.
{add}Three, plus two, plus three. {ans}Eight volts! It's E.
{trap}Four volts? You used one volt for the whole parallel bit.
